texts.label: text
texts.orig: Stable, aqueous  compositions treating  surfaces, especially fabrics; comprise: relatively low molecular weight polyalkyleneoxide polysiloxane surfactant; buffering agent to maintain the pH of the composition in the range of from about 4 to about 10, preferably from about 5 to about 9.5, and more preferably from about 6 to about 9; and an aqueous carrier. The   compositions can further   comprise   catoinic surfactants to further enhance the spreading andlor fabric penetration ability of the compositions. The compositions can further comprise variety of other optional ingredients. Methods of treating surfaces include methods wherein the compositions are contacted with surfaces; especially fabrics, to reduce malodor impression on the surfaces andfor reduce the appearance of wrinkles in fabrics. for
